subject: Payment terms & VAT alignment for Redwood services
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightwave.co.uk>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: James O'Neill <j.oneill@brightwave.co.uk>
Date: 2026-05-09T09:22:00+01:00
Subject: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood services

Hi Monica,

Quick one from our finance team as we prepare the PO for the Q3 rollout. BrightWave operates on a Net60 umbrella for third-party SaaS vendors to align with our buyer payment cycle. Would Redwood be open to Net60 on the annual contract?

A couple of specifics from our side:
- We are in the UK and will likely use the reverse-charge mechanism for VAT for services delivered from outside the UK; can you confirm Redwood will provide VAT invoices with the required wording?
- We may need a temporary uplift on the credit limit for the first 90 days while we onboard; currently our expected monthly spend is ~£45k.

If Net60 is not feasible, please let me know alternatives (Net30/45 with partial upfront). We need confirmation to finish procurement by end of next week.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Head of Procurement
BrightWave Retail Ltd

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightwave.co.uk>
Cc: James O'Neill <j.oneill@brightwave.co.uk>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:08:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood services

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Neha (billing) on VAT specifics and our finance lead Rafael for the credit-side details.

Short answer: we can be flexible, but I want to propose an interim structure that balances your cycle and Redwood's credit exposure while we finalize the amendment:

Proposal (pilot/first 90 days):
- Term: annual master services agreement (no change)
- Payment: Net45 standard across invoices
- Transition: For the first two billing periods we request 30% of the first invoice upfront to cover initial capacity reservation, then Net45 thereafter
- Credit uplift: temporary increase to a £200,000 credit cap for the first 90 days; we will re-evaluate after two billing cycles
- VAT: Redwood will provide VAT invoices and a statement supporting reverse-charge where applicable; Neha will confirm exact wording and attach a sample invoice template.

I've attached a draft of our standard order terms so procurement can review (attachment: SO_Terms_Redwood-v1.pdf). If this looks acceptable I can ask Rafael to issue a formal invoice schedule and DocuSign amendment for signatures.

Proposed next steps:
1) Sophie confirm if Net45 + 30% upfront is acceptable as a compromise
2) BrightWave share any internal PO/approval timeline (we need PO before we provision committed capacity)
3) Redwood sends invoice schedule + DocuSign amendment for countersign

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you'd prefer to run through quickly.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood-inference.com
+44 20 3322 7701

From: James O'Neill <j.oneill@brightwave.co.uk>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightwave.co.uk>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Oliver Price <oliver.price@finance.bw.co.uk>
Date: 2026-05-12T08:47:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood services

Monica / Sophie — thanks for the quick reply. 30% upfront reduces our cash flexibility but is workable if we can get the remainder on Net60 for the first two invoices while our collections window adjusts. Two clarifications from finance:

1) VAT reverse-charge: we will need the supplier VAT registration country listed explicitly on invoices so our VAT team can process correctly.
2) Credit uplift: can you confirm whether the £200k temporary cap is a hard cap or if there is a short approval path to expand if usage exceeds forecast?

Cc'ing Oliver (Finance) to confirm our internal timelines. If we can get the DocuSign amendment by Friday, procurement will try to issue the PO the following Monday.

Regards,
James
Head of Technology Operations
BrightWave Retail Ltd

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood-inference.com>
To: James O'Neill <j.oneill@brightwave.co.uk>, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightwave.co.uk>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T14:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood services — Credit + invoice schedule

Hi all — Rafael here (Finance). Quick answers and a concrete invoice schedule in-line: 

Credit cap: the £200,000 uplift is a firm temporary cap for the first 90 days; if usage projections show >20% variance versus forecast we have a 24-hour escalation path to increase the cap with an approvals email from BW finance. We will document that escalation in the DocuSign amendment.

Invoice cadence (proposed):
- Invoice 1 (upon signature): 30% of first quarter estimate — due on receipt
- Invoice 2 (30 days after Invoice 1): remainder of quarter — Net45
- Invoice 3 (monthly thereafter): Net45

VAT: Neha will attach a sample invoice. For reverse-charge cases we will include: supplier VAT country, supplier VAT number, and the standard EU reverse-charge statement.

Attachments: Invoice_Schedule_BrightWave_v3.xlsx (contains line-item cadence and estimated amounts by month). DocuSign amendment link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF-Redwood-BW-amendment

If that works for BrightWave we'll issue the amendment today and mark it urgent for signature.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brightwave.co.uk>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: James O'Neill <j.oneill@brightwave.co.uk>, Oliver Price <oliver.price@finance.bw.co.uk>
Date: 2026-05-14T11:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood services — Credit + invoice schedule

Thanks Rafael — that schedule is clear and workable. We accept the temporary £200k cap with the documented 24-hour escalation path.

Sophie will sign the DocuSign amendment once we receive it, and procurement aims to issue the PO next Monday (18 May). Oliver, can you confirm PO reference and expected payment window after signature?

Appreciate the quick turnaround from Redwood team — this helps keep our onboarding timeline on track.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Head of Procurement
BrightWave Retail Ltd
